mentions.name: Agent Notifier
mentions.description: Push notification service for AI agents that removes the need to babysit terminals: users get notified with proof of work and can approve key decisions remotely. Notifications render markdown and screenshots, can be delivered as audio, and support approvals plus free-form replies. Also available as an iOS app.
mentions.problem: Running AI agents requires babysitting terminals and being present to approve key decisions as they come up.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Push notifications for AI agents, but better. 
It eliminates baby sitting terminals & let's you go out & approve key decisions while you're also notified of the proof of work.
mentions.author: yashness
